messages.author: d17553208d13f6a8
messages.subject: could not find function g.part1
parts:
Hi Vincent

I'm trying to run GGIR part1 on multiple machines and this is working fine on three of them but one returns the following error when I try to run part1:

> source('U:/SPA Physical Activity Data/ggir/part1 v24May2016.R')
Error in eval(expr, envir, enclos) : could not find function "g.part1"

Are you able to advise at all on what the problem might be? All of the machines are running the most recent version of GGIR and all the required packages are up to date.

Thanks,
Stuart

messages.author: 8d92e34685fbc6bd
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] could not find function g.part1
parts:
Hi Stuart,

This sounds like GGIR is not installed on that machine. Type library(GGIR) on the console command line on the machine that gives problems to test whether it can be loaded.

If not, then:
- Install GGIR
- Restart RStudio or R if you use R directly.
- Type library(GGIR) on the console command line on the machine that gives problems to see whether the package is loaded this time

Additionally, you could check that R and GGIR version are up-to-date and consistent between machines: with commands R.Version()$version.string and packageVersion("GGIR").

Vincent
